gates.workflow: GGEV2 R3-R4 Swarm and Incident Engine

verified_claims: H0-H5 profile inheritance is monotonic under the deterministic test matrix.
Unknown risk classes fail closed with blockers.
Exact repo+ref+SHA evidence is required for every required gate.
FAIL, SKIPPED, CANCELLED, NOT_RUN and misleading PASS-like strings do not count as PASS.
Per-hardness authority ceilings prevent low-rigor promotion jumps.
Hardness execution packets and autoprompt packets are deterministic for identical inputs.
GGEV2 Hardness projection is DERIVED_READ_ONLY and cannot mutate/promote authority.
Escaped-bug learning records require root cause, broken invariant, regression test, failure family and protocol rule.
